sudo.title: Confirm your identity
sudo.description: For your security, please re-enter your password or authenticator code before this action runs.
sudo.helper: Your reauth lasts 5 minutes; rapid follow-up actions will not re-prompt.

openMode.title: Confirm sensitive action
openMode.body: This is a destructive action. Type {{token}} to continue.

errors.totpRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
errors.totpRateLimit: Too many failed authenticator attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.notConfigured: Step-up reauth is not configured on this server. Ask your administrator to set TESLASYNC_SUDO_PASSWORD or TESLASYNC_SUDO_TOTP_SECRET.
